prompts.loading:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: portrait mobile title screen art concept for LobsOfLove.
Input images: image 1 is a material and mechanical-design reference from a CD-case video; image 2 is a restrained electronic instrument reference; image 3 is a miniature-world scale and tactile-detail reference. These are inspiration only. Do not reproduce their logos, lettering, screenshots, browser chrome or subjects.
Create a visually extraordinary collectible tennis game object photographed in a refined warm off-white studio. A thick clear polycarbonate jewel-case-like cartridge, square with gently radiused corners, open lid hinged upward behind it, shown from a carefully composed three-quarter elevated angle. Inside the smoked graphite tray is a complete exquisitely crafted miniature tennis court: matte deep forest green playing surface, accurate delicate ivory tennis court lines, a real fine mesh net with two tiny chrome posts, a tiny optic-yellow tennis ball suspended just above the court. Court runs lengthwise away from viewer. Clear structural ribs, polished transparent edges, small metal hinge pins, real contact shadows and believable refraction. Along the front edge of the cartridge is a compact physical control strip: two recessed amber score windows reading "00" and "00", a single satisfying round optic-yellow rubber button, and a small restrained engraved "LOL" mark. Tennis game as treasured late-1990s industrial design collectible. Hero object occupies middle 65 percent with ample margins. Above the object, exact title "LobsOfLove" in small beautifully spaced black utilitarian sans-serif type; no huge sports logo. Lower 18 percent empty warm off-white for eventual loading UI. Photoreal miniature product render with playful art direction, superb material differentiation: polished chrome, injection molded clear plastic, felt ball, fine mesh, satin rubber. Soft large studio reflections create clean bright and dark bands, directional contact shadow grounding object, moderate depth of field keeps court sharp. Portrait 1024x1536. Quiet, sophisticated, tactile, desirable. No hearts, no graffiti, no speed slashes, no splatter, no neon glow, no purple gradient, no other text, no phone frame, no copied brand marks. One finished artwork, not a concept board.

Design one exquisite miniature tennis cartridge as an app icon. Three-quarter elevated view of a chunky square transparent smoked-polycarbonate game cartridge on a warm off-white background. A tiny deep-forest-green tennis court is inset in its top surface, instantly recognizable with clean ivory boundary and service lines and a fine raised net across center. One slightly oversized fuzzy optic-yellow tennis ball rests near one corner of court as focal point. Foreground edge has a single tiny amber indicator and an optic-yellow round rubber button, just enough physical detail to evoke a collectible electronic toy. Beautiful thick clear perimeter with precise ribs and subtle chrome hinge detail, no open lid to complicate silhouette. Strong simple compact silhouette fills central 78 percent, generous safe margins. High-end tactile miniature product photography, softly grounded contact shadow, large softbox reflections, crisp believable materials, clean studio composition, polished transparent edges, muted graphite, forest green, warm white, concentrated yellow. No text at all, no letters, no hearts, no pink, no neon, no sports swooshes, no clutter, no phone frame, no rounded outer image border. Full bleed square image, one object only.
